lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; the reply's per-policy line 10 test treats column B as correct unless it is blank or zero, an unreported change, or another doubt, and so drops the first situation i8962 p. 14 names: 'If either of these two situations applies to you… you must determine the correct applicable SLCSP premium for every month. If the correct applicable SLCSP premium is not the same for every month of 2025, check “No”… 1. No APTC was paid for your coverage… column B, of Form 1095-A may be wrong, left blank, or reported as -0-.' The project includes it (f1095a.no_aptc, line 33C zero, in f1095a.b_check) and then reads f1095a.b_fixed_same. The reply also returns false for every form not answered as the same every month, where the project tests the monthly entries (f1095a.months_uniform), which the line 10 conditions ('enrolled… for all 12 months', 'enrollment premium was the same for every month', 'SLCSP premium is the same for every month', i8962 p. 14) allow. Its mo_a > 0 test is covered by the f1095a.same_months question ('Answer No if any month is blank in column A'). Decided on the source and the form YAML (triage refuses the form for this pass). Project right.

Ruling: representation; the expression is the project's choose on f1095a.uniform (mo_a against in_a_jan); it differs only through the reply's f1095a.uniform, ruled on that line (no-APTC limb dropped; BUG-0635 for the project's months-differ route). Where the two uniform tests part, same_months is Yes (or b_fixed_same Yes), so column A is the same every month and mo_a equals in_a_jan for a consistent filer (i8962 p. 16, Column (a)). Triage pass ea49629f14d1: 2,393 of 2,842 agree; 391 candidate-unknown (b_doubt/b_blank/b_changed not stated), 57 project-unknown (line 33C withheld); 1 completed value, stage18.reg.no_aptc_slcsp_by_month ($380.00 vs $0.00), where the fixture states the monthly inputs the project asks and not mo_a, which the reply's route would ask.

Ruling: model error; the same deviation the earlier model-error rulings on this line decided. f1095a p. 2, Part III, column B; i8962 p. 16, Column (b): 'Enter the amount from column B of only one Form 1095-A—do not add the amounts from each form. Enter this amount on Form 8962, lines 12 through 23, column (b).' The line is this form's own column B; which form Form 8962 counts is decided there, by f1095a.b_used (the only form, or b_counted) on f8962 lines 12(b)-23(b). The reply zeroes the form's column B when f1095a.b_counted is not Yes, so it contradicts the form on an uncounted form and needs b_counted on a single Form 1095-A, where the interview does not ask it (b_used is true by the form count). Its other differences are representation only: it zeroes a VOID or superseded form, which the project refuses (f8962.void_form; i8962 p. 2, 'Do not use the information on the Form 1095-A with the “VOID” box checked or the previously received Form 1095-A'), and it reads f1095a.in_b_jan where the interview asks f1095a.mo_b for a form answered as the same every month (f1095a.uniform). Triage could not be rerun for this pass (triage.py refuses the form: an older pass names f1095a.uniform, no longer compared); decided on the source and the form YAML. Project right.

Ruling: model error; inherits the column B deviation: the reply zeroes line 33B unless f1095a.b_counted is Yes, so a single Form 1095-A needs b_counted, which the interview does not ask (f1095a.b_used is true by the form count), and an uncounted form's own line 33B is zero, which contradicts i1095a p. 2, 'Total the amounts on lines 21 through 32 and enter on line 33.'
